review:
A Norse 20-liner about raiding the trickster god's stash. The free spins collect prize symbol payouts and can be extended by up to 30 more spins.

Every 10 extra spins in the bonus boosts wins – 2x, then 3x, then 10x – the same escalation as Big Boat Big Catch, so long bonuses really pay off. Chance x2 doubles your free spins odds. Medium volatility, 5,000x max and a 97.2% RTP. Free spins about once every 177 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.20% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
